lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 high-contrast vertical line segments traversing the torso. Spacing is largely equidistant across the mid-section, becoming narrower and fainter toward the posterior rump and anterior shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (far posterior) is abbreviated to a mid-flank segment. Line 8 exhibits a central pixel gap. Line 11 (far anterior) terminates abruptly above the shoulder joint.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two isolated white spots observed on the upper posterior haunch, positioned superior to the white femoral fringe.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate-spiral geometry. Proximal sections project at approx. 45 degrees from the frontal bone, spiraling outward before curving medially and upward at the distal terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 4.8:1 ratio between the pixel distance of the horn tips and the width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approx. 0.10; high-value ivory pixels are restricted to the distal terminal tips of the horn structures.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker on the right lateral neck. Prominent white V-shaped facial chevron. Two distinct white circular spots on the lower cheeks. Dark ventral fringe (mane) extending from the throat to the lower brisket.
